literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) report C-terminal tags on FAM187A or its orthologs (zebrafish Fam187a-3xFLAG-sfGFP in L1; C. elegans SPE-40-eGFP in L2). FAM187A is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein: signal peptide 1–17 is cleaved, the large ectodomain spans residues 18–379, the TM helix spans 380–395, and the C-terminal tail (396–413) is intracellular. A tag appended after residue 413 therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. No ledger line reports a tag at the mature N-terminus (after residue 17) or anywhere within the extracellular domain (18–379). Accordingly, zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: Zebrafish Fam187a-3xFLAG-sfGFP is a C-terminal fusion; the C-terminus of FAM187A (residues 396–413) is intracellular, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
C. elegans SPE-40 (FAM187 ortholog) eGFP knocked in at the endogenous C-terminus; by the same type I topology the C-terminal tag is intracellular, not a surface epitope.
